meta.unit_note: phyid's Gaussian values are in nats; they are divided by ln 2 here. phyid's discrete values are already in bits.
meta.preprocessing: Rows: past = x[:-tau], y[:-tau]; future = x[tau:], y[tau:], i.e. samples (x_t, y_t, x_{t+tau}, y_{t+tau}) for t = 1..N-tau (1-based); local row k has past time t = k. Gaussian: each of the 4 rows is divided by its sample std (ddof=1, no centring); local entropy of subset S = -ln N(X_S; sample mean, np.cov ddof=1); local MI from local entropies. Discrete: each lagged vector binarised as v > mean(v) (identity for these 0/1 series); local entropy = -log2 empirical frequency over the N-tau samples. 'average' = mean of the local rows (phyid returns only local atoms).
meta.local_mmi: Each redundancy (6 single-target PIDs, 1 double redundancy) is the local MI of the source/target pair with the smallest sample-mean local MI; ties: single-target picks the second argument (strict <), double redundancy picks the first of [I(x_p;x_f), I(x_p;y_f), I(y_p;x_f), I(y_p;y_f)] (np.argmin). Local atoms = per-sample solve of the 16x16 Mobius system.
meta.ml_covariance_relation: With the ML covariance (ddof=0) the local atoms are average + N'/(N'-1) * (local - average), N' = N - tau; checked here with max abs deviation 1.449e-14 (nats)
